chart.label: contrast 丁 The Candle, weak, one Order door (fixture: Wood 30 / Fire 15 / Earth 5 / Metal 10 / Water 40)

original.advise_friction: Prudence past its dose becomes fear with a clipboard. Give small decisions a five-minute timer. Reserve real review for the truly irreversible. Once a month, act on a warm impulse the same day it arrives and audit the result later.

repFields.function.definition_catalyst: Water is your Order, and as a catalyst, it is the cool check your intensity needs: reviews, budgets, one person whose calm questions slow you down before the leap. Your best decisions have all survived a night of doubt.
repFields.function.definition_friction: Water is your Order, and as a friction, it is caution soaking through everything: every plan reviewed until the moment passes, every spark second-guessed into a maybe. The checking now costs more than the mistakes would, and the hardest judge of the flame is you.
repFields.function.advise_catalyst: Discipline, for you, is imported, so import it well. Sleep on anything irreversible. Keep a reviewer you cannot charm and show them everything big. Put a cool number on every hot plan before saying yes.
repFields.mechanism.base: The many prevail over the few, and so water commands fire: one flame meets the falling rain, and however bright it burned, the rain does not run out first. What survives learns to burn banked and careful. Rain is the blaze's schooling: after it, fire keeps its heat closer and wastes less light.
repFields.mechanism.catalyst_turn: Run thin, nothing checks the burn: enthusiasm with no depth gauge, light that has never been rained on. Your chart asks for water. Seek the cold reviewer, the quiet counsel.
repFields.mechanism.friction_turn: Run heavy, the rain never lifts: constant drizzle on every spark, caution soaking the kindling before it catches. Step out of the rain. A doused fire serves no one.
repFields.cta_verdict: Pressure reaches you cool and quiet, and the calm authorities you let bank your fire are the reason it lasts the night.
repFields.carry.catalyst: Nothing checks the burn: enthusiasm with no depth gauge, light that has never been rained on. Seek the cold reviewer, the quiet counsel.
repFields.carry.friction: The rain never lifts: constant drizzle on every spark, caution soaking the kindling before it catches. A doused fire serves no one.
repFields.carry.wide: There is no shortage of Water in you, the depth that keeps the burn honest. Take the cold review. Let it steady you.
repFields.carry.missing: Nothing checks the burn: enthusiasm without a gauge, light that has never been rained on. Borrow water: one cold reviewer.
repFields.carry.spared: Water runs absent, and nothing douses the flame: no drizzle on the spark, no second-guessing. Keep it. Choose one check you trust.
repFields.carry.thin: Water runs thin and unwanted: a light rain, easy to shine through. Shine through it.
repFields.carry.excess: Weak fire drowns in strong water: checks past what the flame can survive, caution putting the light out. Get out of the rain. Add wood.
